full_text: The FCC's Consumer Inquiries and Complaints Center is contacting you about the complaint you filed recently, which was assigned Ticket No. 8382473. The FCC received a response from your provider. Your provider must send you a written copy of its response, which may take up to 10 days if sent by mail. You should review the response and reply to this email if the issue remains unresolved. If the FCC does not hear from you within 30 days, the ticket will be closed. New complaints may be filed at consumercomplaints.fcc.gov.
